name: sac-stock-etf-conditioning-2026-10-31
hypothesis: Explicit causal stock/ETF context and group-specific output heads improve shared SAC fit and generalization; no gradient-interference cause assumed.

sampling.group_rule: Choose ETF with probability4/26 and stock with probability22/26, independent of history/outcomes; then sample each group from a seeded shuffled episode deck without replacement until exhausted; uniformly choose a full512-transition window
sampling.episode_cycle: Shuffle each group again only after every member was drawn; no return/regime ranking
sampling.actual_logging: Per-symbol starts/transitions, group starts/transitions, dataset and normalization identities; report actual ETF mass, not just intended probability
sampling.budget_justification: Same expanded111 dataset in both arms,100k for full symbol transition coverage; fixed budget, not an extension of completed diversity study

requirements: Exact111 training symbols, no extras or fallback classification
Per-symbol historical type source and known_from no later than first training session
Retrospective sector/universe snapshots alone cannot establish historical availability
Manifest digest bound to job, checkpoint and frozen bundle

simulation: Unchanged SimulationConfig defaults; four actions,100000 equity, whole shares,cap1,max holding20,next-session execution,costs and adjustments

training_admission.failure: Close family before reading development; no extra steps or rescue

development_gate.failure: Close task-conditioning seed11 family; no extension,confirmation,rescue or promotion

confirmation_gate.interpretation: Development gates only; a frozen prospective comparison remains required

development_access: Only after complete three-role training-admission pass; score previously fixed training-selected and final checkpoints without development reselection

execution.ledger: Original shared cumulative ledger; single persistent study baseline including all attempts,setup,idle,retrieval and smoke
execution.cleanup: Retrieve/checksum and stop/verify every owned session

constraints: Future decline labels reporting only; reconcile long/short net P&L
Fresh controls, same start schedule and transition budgets; report actual group coverage
No PCGrad,PopArt,tag-specific alpha,indicator,reward,width or sampling changes
Training-fit admission does not prove generalization; multi-seed and prospective evidence required
Production type manifest, replay/frozen/worker integration and actual smoke acceptance required before screen
